text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Oguri Cap wants to video-call
the folks back in her hometown to show
them her new
outfit, so I join her to help
out with the camera.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hey, Tome. Can you see my outfit?

text_block_list.name: Tome
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I can! Wooow! It's so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! This outfit was designed by a
fan who
said they wanted to see me
shine brighter.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wearing this makes me feel all warm
inside... It's
sort of like I really am
shining.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to show it to you all
today.
Take a look at how much I've
changed!

text_block_list.name: Shige
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You're running with more vigor
than ever!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Did you see how differently I handled the corners?

text_block_list.name: Shige
text_block_list.text:
Not just your cornering, everything
looked
different! The old you doesn't
even compare!

text_block_list.name: Yone
text_block_list.text:
Before, you would complain that your
legs ached
after just a few laps on dirt...
You're probably
unbeatable now.
Not if I got anythin' to say about it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I heard your whole chat! How 'bout ya try beatin' me before ya go sayin' you're the best? I'm in the mood for a good partner run.

text_block_list.name: Yone
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Who's that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, her name's Tama. She's a friend of
mine... and
my rival.

text_block_list.name: Shige
text_block_list.text: Ooh, your rival! I've gotta see this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Bet! So, c'mon, Oguri. Ya wanna show
the folks back home how bright ya can
shine, yeah? Then you'd better run your
best, or it won't be worth a
ding!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Okay. I accept your
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Sorry Oguri, but I'm takin' the win!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No... you're... not!

text_block_list.name: Shige
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! They're neck and neck! You can
do it,
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Tome
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Look how happy she is. She's
finally found
someone to run against
after all this time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh! I almost had ya! Mark my words,
next
win's gonna be mine!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Nuh-uh... I'll win... next time, too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Dem's fightin' words! In that case, I
better
get to trainin', stat! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Tome
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful friend you've got
there. Thanks
for showing us so much
today, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's one more thing I want
to show
you. I'd like to perform a song,
just like we do
after official races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
After all, concerts are where we get to
thank our
fans for all their support.

text_block_list.name: Tome
text_block_list.text:
Wow, she's amazing. It's like she's
become a real
shining star!

text_block_list.name: Shige
text_block_list.text:
Thanking your fans, huh? I bet she's
been putting
her all into rehearsals.

text_block_list.name: Yone
text_block_list.text:
I remember that cute little girl who
could barely keep rhythm with the beat,
but now look at how
wonderfully she's
grown.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So, what did you think? Was I shining?

text_block_list.name: Tome
text_block_list.text:
You did. I just about had to cover my
eyes. You
really have grown, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Tome
text_block_list.text:
We'll always be here supporting you,
you know.
Even if we can't help you too
much anymore...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone's support is where I get
my
energy from!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I only ever made it this far because you
held me
up and cheered me on even
when I was weak.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I shine because everyone shines. That's
how it's always been, and that's how it's
always gonna be!
I want you all to know
that.

text_block_list.name: Yone
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Shige, are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Shige
text_block_list.text:
You're looking a bit misty-eyed yourself,
Yone.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Is there anything you want to add
too,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: Looks like it got across loud and ...
Looks like it got across loud and ...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're the one directly responsible for
my
brightness. That's why I think they
should hear
from you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Thank you!
choice_data_list: I'll make sure her dream comes true!
I still have much to learn, but I ...

text_block_list.name: Tome
text_block_list.text:
That's just the determination I'd expect
from Oguri's trainer! I sure hope you'll
come pay us a visit sometime. We'll have
a great big pot of beef tendon stew
waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, beef tendon stew! That's totally
right,
Tome's stew tastes amazing!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I bet you'll love it too,
Trainer! Let's visit
my
hometown together soon!

text_block_list.name: Shige
text_block_list.text:
W-well, I'd wish you good luck, but I
don't think you need it! You're a heck of
a trainer, y'know,
taking care of Oguri
on your lonesome like that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, now that you mention it, it's pretty
amazing how Trainer alone has
basically taken on
everyone's roles to
support me.

text_block_list.name: Shige
text_block_list.text:
It sure is. I remember birthdays and
holidays always being reeeal tough...
although, I guess Oguri always asking
Santa for the same gift made things
easier.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: C-c'mon, Shige... I'm going red here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap might be blushing, but to me,
those
look like the rosy cheeks of a
happy girl.
